title: Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Construction of Cities for the Relocation of Provincial Government Offices and Support Therefor
title_original: 도청이전을 위한 도시건설 및 지원에 관한 특별법 시행령
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Construction of Cities for the Relocation of Provincial Government Offices and Support Therefor

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated under the Special Act on the Construction of Cities for the Relocation of Provincial Government Offices and Support Therefor, and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Gratuitous Transfer or Loan of Former Provincial Government Office Buildings and Sites, etc.)
(1) A gratuitous transfer or gratuitous loan of former provincial government office buildings and sites under Article 31-2 (2) of the Special Act on the Construction of Cities for the Relocation of Provincial Government Offices and Support Therefor shall be effected pursuant to a contract between the head of the central government agency under Article 6 of the National Finance Act that manages the relevant real property (hereinafter referred to as the "management authority") and the metropolitan-level local government having jurisdiction over its location.
(2) If a metropolitan-level local government having jurisdiction over the location of real property received by gratuitous transfer or gratuitous loan under paragraph (1) uses such real property for a purpose other than that of the gratuitous transfer or loan, the management authority may terminate or rescind the relevant agreement for gratuitous transfer or loan.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 28006, May 2, 2017>

This Decree shall enter into force on May 9, 2017.
